findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/MvPowerSeries/Rename.lean:300 `theorem rename_eq_subst : rename f p = p.subst (X ∘ f)` and :293 `lemma HasSubst.X_comp`; the repo already uses `rename_eq_subst` at TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/EllipticCurve/FormalGroup/Basic.lean:89 and the repo's `MvPowerSeries.aeval_subst` is TauCeti/RingTheory/MvPowerSeries/Substitution.lean:117. So the PR description's claim that the commutativity route "needs an `eval₂`-of-`rename` transport that neither Mathlib nor this repository has" does not hold. Add/Unit.lean:275-284 derives the left series law from the right one by exactly this swap, so the parameter level should mirror it.
findings.fix: Prove `formalAddEval_comm` from `rename_swap_formalAdd` — `MvPowerSeries.rename_eq_subst` turns `rename Sum.swap` into `subst (X ∘ Sum.swap)` (`HasSubst.X_comp`), and `MvPowerSeries.aeval_subst` with `ε := aeval (hasEval_pair h₁ h₂)` sends it to evaluation at the swapped pair — then let `formalAddEval_zero_left` be `(W.formalAddEval_comm ..).trans (W.formalAddEval_zero_right ht)`. Alternatively factor the shared skeleton into one private lemma `eval₂ id t (subst (Sum.elim (fun _ ↦ q₁) (fun _ ↦ q₂)) W.formalAdd) = W.formalAddEval (eval₂ id t q₁) (eval₂ id t q₂)` and instantiate it three times (both unit laws and `formalAddEval_formalInverseEval`).
findings.issue: `formalAddEval_zero_left` (366-387) re-proves the whole 20-line transport of `formalAddEval_zero_right` (341-362) with the two `Sum.elim` slots swapped, instead of being derived from a general result. The general statement is the parameter-level swap `W.formalAddEval t₁ t₂ = W.formalAddEval t₂ t₁` (for `HasEval t₁`, `HasEval t₂`), which is also what milestone (iii) needs for `Ê(𝔪)` to be an abelian group.

summary: The two unit laws sit at the right level and carry no excess hypotheses, but the left law is a line-for-line mirror of the right one rather than a consequence of a general fact, and the PR's stated reason for not deriving it is wrong: Mathlib's `rename_eq_subst` plus the repo's own `aeval_subst` give the parameter-level swap in a few lines.
